description:
BiosSchema is the BIOS attribute registry discovered on one machine: which settings that machine's firmware actually has, what each one accepts, and which are read-only. It is written by the cluster, not by hand — it is how you find out what a BiosProfile is allowed to ask for.

Cluster-scoped, named after its Host and owned by it.

fields.name: spec
fields.description: BiosSchemaSpec is the discovered attribute registry of one host's BIOS. Like Asset it is spec-only — the object IS the data; nothing about it is derived further. The convergence reconciler writes it from the registry that the Bios resource names. The client normalizes the registry name, because the Bios resource, the Registries member and the file spell it differently on both vendors.

fields.name: attributes
fields.description: Attributes lists the registry's entries, sorted by name. The operator checks the desired values of a BiosSettings against this list before it proposes an operation. Without the check, the machine would refuse an unknown attribute, and it would ignore a value out of range.

fields.name: allowedValues
fields.description: AllowedValues enumerates the legal values; empty for non-enumerations.

fields.name: type
fields.description: Type is the registry's attribute type: Enumeration, Boolean, Integer or String — kept as served.

fields.name: registry
fields.description: Registry is the registry identity as the Bios resource advertises it, kept verbatim (e.g. BiosAttributeRegistry.v1_0_0).
